Mike, saw HSI launched Sky and the Enhesa regulatory module while expanding globally through recent acquisitions.

Our AI SDR turns signals into researched, written, followed-up outreach automatically, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for HSI off hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes to walk you through it?
